description: Update an existing Residency Rule in OneUptime. Only include the fields you want to change - unspecified fields will remain unchanged. Use get_residency_rule afterwards to see the updated record.

allowedRegions.description: The regions the data may live in. A * matches any characters: eu-*, europe-*, westeurope.

dataCategories.description: The categories of data the rule covers. Empty means every kind of personal data.

description.example: This is an example of longer text content that might be stored in this field.

id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the Residency Rule to update. Required. Use list_residency_rules to find IDs.

name.description: The rule's name, such as EU personal data stays in the EU.

subjectCountries.description: Only data about people in these countries (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Empty means data about anyone.

name: update_residency_rule
title: Update Residency Rule
